zhHans.headline: 紫微斗数结构总览
zhHans.summary: 命宫太阴与身宫落迁移，使决定先经内部评估，再由外部情境、事业标准与资源可持续性推动落地。；福德宫火星、巨门与天钺共同显示，内在恢复并非单靠休息，而靠及时动员、澄清隐含假设与接受精准协助。；官禄宫天梁、文昌与文曲把事业价值放在监督修复、结构化表达与意义传达，并须由迁移宫的减负能力维持交付。；财帛宫禄存、太阳与田宅宫廉贞、天相、右弼要求把资源取得、公开贡献、留存容量和角色分配分开衡量。；夫妻宫铃星与天机使关系运行重视未解张力的讯号，并通过交流、调整选项与重新协商来维持互惠和边界。；父母、兄弟与仆役宫构成分散式支持网络，其中兄弟宫紫微、天府同宫强调由不同角色分别定义优先级与保存容量。；疾厄宫陀罗与武曲描述的是压力容量：耐心持续与纪律执行可以承载长期任务，但必须容许定期重评和情境调整。；当前大限以子女宫破军、擎羊提高更新与边界取舍的读取优先级，但只是重排事业、支持网络和压力容量的关注顺序。；流年以田宅宫为焦点，使基础安排、角色程序与投入边界更显眼，并联动迁移、夫妻及官禄宫的协商与表达要求。；整盘导航应同时核对决定如何落地、事业交付、资源留存、关系互惠与压力恢复，并把本命、大限和流年的作用分层读取。

en.headline: Zi Wei Dou Shu Structural Overview
en.summary: Tai Yin in Life with the Body anchored in Travel links inward appraisal to execution through context, career standards, and durable resources.; Huo Xing, Ju Men, and Tian Yue in Wellbeing frame recovery as timely activation, clarified assumptions, and precisely matched assistance.; Tian Liang, Wen Chang, and Wen Qu place career value in repair, structured communication, and meaning, sustained by reduced friction.; Lu Cun and Tai Yang in Wealth, with the Property structure, separate acquisition, visible contribution, retained capacity, and role allocation.; Ling Xing and Tian Ji in Spouse emphasize unresolved relational signals, using dialogue and revised options to sustain reciprocity and boundaries.; Parents, Siblings, and Friends form distributed support, while Zi Wei with Tian Fu separates priority-setting from capacity-holding roles.; Tuo Luo and Wu Qu in Health describe pressure capacity: patient persistence and disciplined execution require periodic reassessment and adjustment.; The current Da Xian prioritizes Po Jun and Qing Yang themes of renewal and boundary decisions without replacing the natal baseline.; The annual focus on Property highlights foundations, role procedures, and investment boundaries alongside relational and career coordination.; Whole-chart navigation integrates execution, career delivery, retained resources, reciprocity, and recovery while separating natal and timing layers.

zhHans.headline: 核心运行方式
zhHans.subheadline: 命身共同形成从决定到落地的轴线

keyInsights.label: 核心结构
keyInsights.text: 命宫太阴与身宫落迁移，使决定先经内部评估，再由外部情境、事业标准与资源可持续性推动落地。

keyInsights.label: 现实表现
keyInsights.text: 面对新机会时，常会先观察支持条件与长期影响，随后选择既能维持关系缓冲、又有明确交付标准的路径。

keyInsights.label: 反向与制衡
keyInsights.text: 压力升高时，审慎可能变成沉默退缩，外部缓冲也可能被过度使用为求安稳、等援助或回避边界的理由。

interpretation: 命宫太阴与身宫落迁移，使决定先经内部评估，再由外部情境、事业标准与资源可持续性推动落地。 面对新机会时，常会先观察支持条件与长期影响，随后选择既能维持关系缓冲、又有明确交付标准的路径。
压力升高时，审慎可能变成沉默退缩，外部缓冲也可能被过度使用为求安稳、等援助或回避边界的理由。 以一个正在考虑的机会作现实检验，观察它是否同时具备独立判断空间、可用资源与不逃避困难任务的条件。

en.headline: Core Orientation
en.subheadline: 命身共同形成从决定到落地的轴线

keyInsights.label: Core structure
keyInsights.text: Tai Yin in Life with the Body anchored in Travel links inward appraisal to execution through context, career standards, and durable resources.

keyInsights.label: Lived expression
keyInsights.text: When an opportunity appears, you may first test its support and long-term effects, then choose a path with continuity and clear delivery standards.

keyInsights.label: Counterweight
keyInsights.text: Under strain, careful appraisal can become silent withdrawal, while harmony is overused as a reason to wait for rescue or avoid firm boundaries.

interpretation: Tai Yin in Life with the Body anchored in Travel links inward appraisal to execution through context, career standards, and durable resources. When an opportunity appears, you may first test its support and long-term effects, then choose a path with continuity and clear delivery standards.

Under strain, careful appraisal can become silent withdrawal, while harmony is overused as a reason to wait for rescue or avoid firm boundaries. Test one live opportunity by observing whether it preserves independent judgment, usable resources, and willingness to face the difficult part.

zhHans.headline: 内部结构
zhHans.subheadline: 内在恢复取决于标准、投入与停止条件

keyInsights.label: 核心结构
keyInsights.text: 福德宫火星、巨门与天钺共同显示，内在恢复并非单靠休息，而靠及时动员、澄清隐含假设与接受精准协助。

keyInsights.label: 现实表现
keyInsights.text: 遇到复杂问题时，常会迅速进入处理状态，以追问找出症结，并在恰当支持到位后重新获得思考与行动容量。

keyInsights.label: 反向与制衡
keyInsights.text: 压力过高时，快速动员会跑在信息之前，提问变成争辩与怀疑，而协助关系也可能滑向拯救义务或互惠失衡。

interpretation: 福德宫火星、巨门与天钺共同显示，内在恢复并非单靠休息，而靠及时动员、澄清隐含假设与接受精准协助。 遇到复杂问题时，常会迅速进入处理状态，以追问找出症结，并在恰当支持到位后重新获得思考与行动容量。
压力过高时，快速动员会跑在信息之前，提问变成争辩与怀疑，而协助关系也可能滑向拯救义务或互惠失衡。 观察一次高压处理过程，若明确停止点、精准问题与外部协助确实恢复了容量，才提高这套解释的权重。

en.headline: Inner Structure
en.subheadline: 内在恢复取决于标准、投入与停止条件

keyInsights.label: Core structure
keyInsights.text: Huo Xing, Ju Men, and Tian Yue in Wellbeing frame recovery as timely activation, clarified assumptions, and precisely matched assistance.

keyInsights.label: Lived expression
keyInsights.text: In a complex situation, you may mobilize quickly, question toward the hidden issue, and regain capacity once suitable support becomes available.

keyInsights.label: Counterweight
keyInsights.text: Under strain, action outruns information, inquiry turns into argument or distrust, and assistance becomes rescue duty or uneven reciprocity.

interpretation: Huo Xing, Ju Men, and Tian Yue in Wellbeing frame recovery as timely activation, clarified assumptions, and precisely matched assistance. In a complex situation, you may mobilize quickly, question toward the hidden issue, and regain capacity once suitable support becomes available.

Under strain, action outruns information, inquiry turns into argument or distrust, and assistance becomes rescue duty or uneven reciprocity. Observe one pressured episode and give this reading more weight only if a stop point, exact question, and apt support restore capacity.

zhHans.headline: 工作与方向
zhHans.subheadline: 事业主轴是重组能力怎样变成可持续成果

keyInsights.label: 核心结构
keyInsights.text: 官禄宫天梁、文昌与文曲把事业价值放在监督修复、结构化表达与意义传达，并须由迁移宫的减负能力维持交付。

keyInsights.label: 现实表现
keyInsights.text: 工作中容易承担检查偏差、整理标准、记录教学或诠释呈现的任务，并通过降低无谓摩擦使团队持续运作。

keyInsights.label: 反向与制衡
keyInsights.text: 压力下，保护性监督会膨胀为不断补位，结构表达变成僵化修订，细腻呈现则可能滑向形象管理或脱离事实。

interpretation: 官禄宫天梁、文昌与文曲把事业价值放在监督修复、结构化表达与意义传达，并须由迁移宫的减负能力维持交付。 工作中容易承担检查偏差、整理标准、记录教学或诠释呈现的任务，并通过降低无谓摩擦使团队持续运作。
压力下，保护性监督会膨胀为不断补位，结构表达变成僵化修订，细腻呈现则可能滑向形象管理或脱离事实。 检验一项近期交付，分别看它是否纠正了真实偏差、让他人能够行动，并在表达精细度增加时仍保留事实锚点。

en.headline: Work & Direction
en.subheadline: 事业主轴是重组能力怎样变成可持续成果

keyInsights.label: Core structure
keyInsights.text: Tian Liang, Wen Chang, and Wen Qu place career value in repair, structured communication, and meaning, sustained by reduced friction.

keyInsights.label: Lived expression
keyInsights.text: At work, you may inspect drift, organize standards, document or teach, and interpret material while lowering needless team burden.

keyInsights.label: Counterweight
keyInsights.text: Under strain, supervision becomes endless repair, structure becomes rigid revision, and polished meaning drifts into image management.

interpretation: Tian Liang, Wen Chang, and Wen Qu place career value in repair, structured communication, and meaning, sustained by reduced friction. At work, you may inspect drift, organize standards, document or teach, and interpret material while lowering needless team burden.

Under strain, supervision becomes endless repair, structure becomes rigid revision, and polished meaning drifts into image management. Test a recent deliverable by asking whether it corrected real drift, enabled action, and stayed anchored in facts as refinement increased.

zhHans.headline: 资源与财富
zhHans.subheadline: 财富要分开读取取得、分配、留存与选择空间

keyInsights.label: 核心结构
keyInsights.text: 财帛宫禄存、太阳与田宅宫廉贞、天相、右弼要求把资源取得、公开贡献、留存容量和角色分配分开衡量。

keyInsights.label: 现实表现
keyInsights.text: 现实中可能一面保留缓冲与重新调配空间，一面把资源投入可见用途，并在家庭或基础安排中协调程序与支援。

keyInsights.label: 反向与制衡
keyInsights.text: 压力下，留存会变成防守与惯性，公开贡献演成单向耗竭，而田宅协调则可能出现控制拉扯、讨好或责任模糊。

interpretation: 财帛宫禄存、太阳与田宅宫廉贞、天相、右弼要求把资源取得、公开贡献、留存容量和角色分配分开衡量。 现实中可能一面保留缓冲与重新调配空间，一面把资源投入可见用途，并在家庭或基础安排中协调程序与支援。
压力下，留存会变成防守与惯性，公开贡献演成单向耗竭，而田宅协调则可能出现控制拉扯、讨好或责任模糊。 比较一项资源安排的账面投入与实际使用，观察它是否保留周转容量，并让受益、决定权及后续维护彼此相称。

en.headline: Resources & Wealth
en.subheadline: 财富要分开读取取得、分配、留存与选择空间

keyInsights.label: Core structure
keyInsights.text: Lu Cun and Tai Yang in Wealth, with the Property structure, separate acquisition, visible contribution, retained capacity, and role allocation.

keyInsights.label: Lived expression
keyInsights.text: You may preserve a buffer while directing resources into visible use, then coordinate procedures and support around home or infrastructure.

keyInsights.label: Counterweight
keyInsights.text: Under strain, retention becomes defensive inertia, contribution becomes one-way depletion, and coordination turns controlling or role-blurred.

interpretation: Lu Cun and Tai Yang in Wealth, with the Property structure, separate acquisition, visible contribution, retained capacity, and role allocation. You may preserve a buffer while directing resources into visible use, then coordinate procedures and support around home or infrastructure.

Under strain, retention becomes defensive inertia, contribution becomes one-way depletion, and coordination turns controlling or role-blurred. Compare the stated input and actual use of one resource arrangement, noting whether capacity, authority, benefit, and upkeep remain proportionate.

zhHans.headline: 关系运行
zhHans.subheadline: 关系重点是互惠、位置、边界与修复

keyInsights.label: 核心结构
keyInsights.text: 夫妻宫铃星与天机使关系运行重视未解张力的讯号，并通过交流、调整选项与重新协商来维持互惠和边界。

keyInsights.label: 现实表现
keyInsights.text: 当互动出现细微变化时，常会持续观察并重想方案，直到双方能说清误解、选择与旧安排是否仍然适用。

keyInsights.label: 反向与制衡
keyInsights.text: 压力下，敏锐观察会变成慢性警报，适应性思考则碎裂为犹豫和反复改案，甚至把普通摩擦视为紧急讯号。

interpretation: 夫妻宫铃星与天机使关系运行重视未解张力的讯号，并通过交流、调整选项与重新协商来维持互惠和边界。 当互动出现细微变化时，常会持续观察并重想方案，直到双方能说清误解、选择与旧安排是否仍然适用。
压力下，敏锐观察会变成慢性警报，适应性思考则碎裂为犹豫和反复改案，甚至把普通摩擦视为紧急讯号。 选取一次近期关系分歧，区分可观察事实、尚未验证的讯号与真正需要行动的阈值，再看沟通后选项是否变清楚。

en.headline: Relationships
en.subheadline: 关系重点是互惠、位置、边界与修复

keyInsights.label: Core structure
keyInsights.text: Ling Xing and Tian Ji in Spouse emphasize unresolved relational signals, using dialogue and revised options to sustain reciprocity and boundaries.

keyInsights.label: Lived expression
keyInsights.text: When interaction subtly shifts, you may keep observing and revising possibilities until both parties clarify the misunderstanding and choices.

keyInsights.label: Counterweight
keyInsights.text: Under strain, sensitivity becomes chronic alarm, while adaptive thought fragments into indecision, repeated redesign, or emergency framing.

interpretation: Ling Xing and Tian Ji in Spouse emphasize unresolved relational signals, using dialogue and revised options to sustain reciprocity and boundaries. When interaction subtly shifts, you may keep observing and revising possibilities until both parties clarify the misunderstanding and choices.

Under strain, sensitivity becomes chronic alarm, while adaptive thought fragments into indecision, repeated redesign, or emergency framing. For one recent disagreement, separate observable facts from unverified signals and the true action threshold, then note whether dialogue clarifies choices.

zhHans.headline: 家庭与支持
zhHans.subheadline: 稳定支持来自功能分散

keyInsights.label: 核心结构
keyInsights.text: 父母、兄弟与仆役宫构成分散式支持网络，其中兄弟宫紫微、天府同宫强调由不同角色分别定义优先级与保存容量。

keyInsights.label: 现实表现
keyInsights.text: 家庭或同侪合作中，常有人负责定方向、有人维持供给，也有人处理移动与临时协调，稳定来自功能分工而非单点承担。

keyInsights.label: 反向与制衡
keyInsights.text: 压力下，中心协调可能转为控制与过载，稳定承载变成资源防守，频繁切换与过量承诺也会削弱日常可靠度。

interpretation: 父母、兄弟与仆役宫构成分散式支持网络，其中兄弟宫紫微、天府同宫强调由不同角色分别定义优先级与保存容量。 家庭或同侪合作中，常有人负责定方向、有人维持供给，也有人处理移动与临时协调，稳定来自功能分工而非单点承担。
压力下，中心协调可能转为控制与过载，稳定承载变成资源防守，频繁切换与过量承诺也会削弱日常可靠度。 观察一次支持中断时各角色实际补上的功能，若方向、容量、移动与协调总落在同一人身上，便不能视为分散支持。

en.headline: Family & Support
en.subheadline: 稳定支持来自功能分散

keyInsights.label: Core structure
keyInsights.text: Parents, Siblings, and Friends form distributed support, while Zi Wei with Tian Fu separates priority-setting from capacity-holding roles.

keyInsights.label: Lived expression
keyInsights.text: In family or peer cooperation, one person may set direction, another maintain supply, and another handle movement or immediate coordination.

keyInsights.label: Counterweight
keyInsights.text: Under strain, coordination becomes control and overload, stable holding becomes resource defense, and constant switching erodes reliability.

interpretation: Parents, Siblings, and Friends form distributed support, while Zi Wei with Tian Fu separates priority-setting from capacity-holding roles. In family or peer cooperation, one person may set direction, another maintain supply, and another handle movement or immediate coordination.

Under strain, coordination becomes control and overload, stable holding becomes resource defense, and constant switching erodes reliability. Observe a support disruption and identify who actually restored direction, capacity, mobility, and coordination; one-person coverage is not distributed support.

zhHans.headline: 压力与脆弱点
zhHans.subheadline: 压力读取关注负荷累积而非疾病

keyInsights.label: 核心结构
keyInsights.text: 疾厄宫陀罗与武曲描述的是压力容量：耐心持续与纪律执行可以承载长期任务，但必须容许定期重评和情境调整。

keyInsights.label: 现实表现
keyInsights.text: 面对拖滞事务时，往往会持续加力、量化进度并维持运作，即使柔性讯号或恢复需求尚未被他人看见。

keyInsights.label: 反向与制衡
keyInsights.text: 压力累积后，持续会扭曲为无尽拖延与循环用力，纪律则过度化为僵硬、交易式判断或凡事只认量化结果。

interpretation: 疾厄宫陀罗与武曲描述的是压力容量：耐心持续与纪律执行可以承载长期任务，但必须容许定期重评和情境调整。 面对拖滞事务时，往往会持续加力、量化进度并维持运作，即使柔性讯号或恢复需求尚未被他人看见。
压力累积后，持续会扭曲为无尽拖延与循环用力，纪律则过度化为僵硬、交易式判断或凡事只认量化结果。 查看一项长期卡住的任务，若增加投入并未改变阻塞结构，且非量化讯号持续被忽略，就应降低单靠执行的解释权重。

en.headline: Pressure & Vulnerability
en.subheadline: 压力读取关注负荷累积而非疾病

keyInsights.label: Core structure
keyInsights.text: Tuo Luo and Wu Qu in Health describe pressure capacity: patient persistence and disciplined execution require periodic reassessment and adjustment.

keyInsights.label: Lived expression
keyInsights.text: With a stalled task, you may keep applying effort, measure progress, and preserve function even when softer signals or recovery needs stay unseen.

keyInsights.label: Counterweight
keyInsights.text: Under strain, persistence distorts into endless delay and repeated force, while discipline becomes rigid, transactional, or exclusively quantitative.

interpretation: Tuo Luo and Wu Qu in Health describe pressure capacity: patient persistence and disciplined execution require periodic reassessment and adjustment. With a stalled task, you may keep applying effort, measure progress, and preserve function even when softer signals or recovery needs stay unseen.

Under strain, persistence distorts into endless delay and repeated force, while discipline becomes rigid, transactional, or exclusively quantitative. Examine one long-stalled task; if added effort does not alter the blockage and softer signals stay ignored, discount execution as the sole answer.

zhHans.headline: 长期周期
zhHans.subheadline: 大限改变读取优先级但不改写本命

keyInsights.label: 核心结构
keyInsights.text: 当前大限以子女宫破军、擎羊提高更新与边界取舍的读取优先级，但只是重排事业、支持网络和压力容量的关注顺序。

keyInsights.label: 现实表现
keyInsights.text: 这一阶段更容易遇到旧安排需要拆解重组的情境，并须在保留有效部分的同时，直接处理合作边界与现实摩擦。

keyInsights.label: 反向与制衡
keyInsights.text: 压力下，更新会被过度使用为连续推翻与失稳，直接处理边界也可能升级成僵硬对抗，把摩擦误认作敌意证据。

interpretation: 当前大限以子女宫破军、擎羊提高更新与边界取舍的读取优先级，但只是重排事业、支持网络和压力容量的关注顺序。 这一阶段更容易遇到旧安排需要拆解重组的情境，并须在保留有效部分的同时，直接处理合作边界与现实摩擦。
压力下，更新会被过度使用为连续推翻与失稳，直接处理边界也可能升级成僵硬对抗，把摩擦误认作敌意证据。 检验一项正在重组的安排，若有效部分被保留、边界处理后可继续运作，才支持大限主题正在建设性显现。

en.headline: Long-term Cycles
en.subheadline: 大限改变读取优先级但不改写本命

keyInsights.label: Core structure
keyInsights.text: The current Da Xian prioritizes Po Jun and Qing Yang themes of renewal and boundary decisions without replacing the natal baseline.

keyInsights.label: Lived expression
keyInsights.text: This phase may foreground situations where old arrangements need restructuring while useful parts and workable cooperation are preserved.

keyInsights.label: Counterweight
keyInsights.text: Under strain, renewal becomes repeated demolition and instability, while direct boundaries harden into conflict or proof of presumed hostility.

interpretation: The current Da Xian prioritizes Po Jun and Qing Yang themes of renewal and boundary decisions without replacing the natal baseline. This phase may foreground situations where old arrangements need restructuring while useful parts and workable cooperation are preserved.

Under strain, renewal becomes repeated demolition and instability, while direct boundaries harden into conflict or proof of presumed hostility. Test one active restructuring: the cycle is constructive only if useful parts remain and the arrangement still works after boundaries are addressed.

zhHans.headline: 当前时序

zhHans.headline: 现实导航
zhHans.subheadline: 先保护可用资源、边界与恢复空间

keyInsights.label: 核心结构
keyInsights.text: 整盘导航应同时核对决定如何落地、事业交付、资源留存、关系互惠与压力恢复，并把本命、大限和流年的作用分层读取。

keyInsights.label: 现实表现
keyInsights.text: 现实中最关键的情境，是同一承诺同时牵动工作责任、可用资源、关系位置与恢复容量，而年度焦点又让其中一项更显眼。

keyInsights.label: 反向与制衡
keyInsights.text: 压力下，能够承担容易被扭曲成应该继续承担，若决定权、资源或恢复空间未明，扩张承诺只会放大责任失配。
